title: Authority
description: An entity with interpretive or regulatory power over Instruments and Proceedings. Bound to gist:Organization (or subtype). Every Authority's right to act traces to an Instrument via authority_basis.

@type.description: A gist:Organization or subtype IRI (e.g., gist:GovernmentOrganization). gist defines no Court class; courts and tribunals use gist:GovernmentOrganization (an adopter MAY subtype it locally).

kind.description: Closed vocabulary describing why the Authority has authority. Statutory = granted by enacted law. Regulatory = delegated by an administrative process. Contractual = granted by agreement. Corporate = granted by bylaws or charter. Judicial = inherent to a court or tribunal.

instrument_ref.description: IRI of the Instrument that grants this Authority's right to act.

ref.description: Jurisdiction code: lowercase form of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country/supranational code or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (also covers ELI member-state codes, which are ISO 3166-1).

sameAs.description: owl:sameAs crosswalk IRIs: external records identical to this one (e.g. a live adopter export or a Wikidata QID, per the crosswalk matrix in PROTOCOL.md).

exactMatch.description: skos:exactMatch crosswalk IRIs: external concepts interchangeably usable with this record. Weaker than owl:sameAs; preferred for cross-scheme concept joins.

notes.description: Free-text editorial or provenance notes about this record.
